Solving a wrong-item order after payment is a different task from selecting a convenient way to pay for the correct order.

sections.heading: Check methods in the current checkout
paragraphs: LoloBuy's public buying guide names several payment categories, including cards, Chinese payment services and bank transfer. A general help list is background information, not proof that every method is currently available for every account, country, currency or bill. Read the methods actually offered for your transaction and any eligibility or verification information displayed beside them.

Do not infer a current fee or settlement time from a logo in an older tutorial. If a channel is unavailable, preserve the visible message and check official support rather than assuming that a different country selection is appropriate. Use your actual billing details. If the checkout asks for a currency choice, record it before comparing another channel so that the two totals describe equivalent purchases.

sections.heading: Separate the cost layers
paragraphs: A complete comparison distinguishes the underlying bill, a platform payment charge, currency conversion and any external provider charge. Some of these may be included in a displayed total; others may be shown separately by the bank or payment provider. Record what is known and what remains to be checked. Avoid adding a fee twice merely because it appears on both a breakdown and a final total.

For a percentage charge, identify the amount to which that percentage applies. For a fixed charge, record the currency and whether it is per transaction. A small purchase can be affected differently by a fixed fee than a larger one. This guide does not publish a permanent fee table because the useful number is the complete amount you would authorise for the current bill under the current terms.

sections.heading: Compare the same bill in one currency
paragraphs: Suppose two payment screens refer to the same illustrative goods bill. One shows an all-in debit of 102 units of your spending currency and another shows 104. If the lower number excludes an additional provider charge, the comparison is incomplete. Record the confirmed total for each option and state any unresolved charge rather than presenting the headline figure as the final cost.

When the account is credited in one currency and your bank debits another, keep both amounts. Dividing the credited amount by the actual debit gives an effective conversion measure for that particular transaction. It does not establish the platform's universal exchange rate. Use the same time and bill when comparing alternatives, and distinguish a quoted rate from the final amount recorded after settlement.

sections.heading: Keep account funding and order payment separate
paragraphs: Adding funds to a platform account creates a balance entry. Paying an order uses funds or another payment channel to settle a specific bill. These events may be close together but they answer different questions. After funding, check the credit entry; after paying, check the associated order or parcel status. A balance increase alone does not prove that the intended order has been paid.

A compact ledger can use one row for the external payment, one for the balance credit and one for the order deduction, with references linking them. This is particularly useful when funding more than one order. Avoid treating the remaining balance as a discount on your next purchase: it is money whose earlier funding cost still belongs in your overall records. Record unused funds separately from completed purchase costs.

sections.heading: Handle a pending or failed payment carefully
paragraphs: If a payment page stalls or reports a failure, compare the bill status, account history and provider record before repeating the transaction. A pending bank authorisation and a confirmed platform payment are different states. Save the time, transaction reference and exact message. Those facts allow support to investigate a specific attempt instead of guessing from a screenshot of the current balance.

If the provider shows a debit but the bill remains unpaid, contact the relevant support channel with the linked records. Do not assume that every pending item will settle or reverse within one universal period. Ask which status is confirmed and what action is required. When sharing evidence, redact full card details and unrelated account activity. Keep the transaction identifiers needed to match the case.

sections.heading: Understand where a refund goes
paragraphs: LoloBuy's return guidance generally describes eligible refunds being credited to the LoloBuy account balance. It also describes a narrow exception for certain PayPal orders awaiting approval. That exception should not be rewritten as a promise that every refund returns automatically to the original payment method. Check the rule attached to the actual order stage and payment record.

Distinguish the seller approving a return, the platform receiving money, the account receiving a credit and money reaching your external account. Each stage needs its own evidence. A balance credit can settle one part of the process without establishing that funds have been withdrawn. Before relying on withdrawal, check the live eligibility, available action and applicable conditions for that balance. Do not assume that an unused balance has identical treatment in every case.

sections.heading: Review freight adjustments independently
paragraphs: International freight starts as a separate estimate in the official buying process. Later packing or logistics measurements can produce an additional amount or an overpayment credit. Match any adjustment to the parcel number and final measurements. An extra freight bill is not automatically a payment-method fee, and a freight credit is not necessarily a reversal of the original goods purchase.

Retain the initial freight amount, changed measurements, final amount and any credit or supplemental payment. If a line item is unclear, ask which part of the parcel calculation changed. Separate this reconciliation from destination taxes or carrier handling charges that may follow another process. Keeping the categories distinct makes a total easier to audit and helps you avoid paying an unfamiliar request without understanding its connection to the parcel.

sections.heading: Save a payment record that remains useful
paragraphs: A useful payment record contains the date, bill subject, order or parcel reference, base amount, displayed fee, settlement currency, final payable amount and provider transaction reference. Add the resulting platform status and balance movement after payment. For a refund, attach the source order and the destination of the credit. These fields connect what you intended to pay with what actually happened.

Before the next payment, repeat the current-checkout comparison. Method availability, conversion and charges can change, so a previous successful transaction is a reference rather than a permanent rate card. Choose among the methods genuinely offered for your bill, compare the complete debit and retain the evidence. If a required fee or refund condition remains unclear, resolve that specific uncertainty through official support before committing the payment.

checklist: Match the payment to the exact order or parcel bill.
Compare current fees and final debit in the same currency.
Check whether a balance credit also settled the intended bill.
Resolve ambiguous payment status before repeating it.
Verify whether a refund reached platform balance or the original payment method.

articles.title: LoloBuy link not working: Taobao, Weidian and 1688 checks
articles.description: Troubleshoot a LoloBuy product link by separating seller availability, link format and order parsing, then verify the exact item before a manual order.
articles.summary: Preserve the original product link and identify where it fails. Recover the same item and variant, then review the imported order instead of changing IDs or guessing missing details.

sections.heading: Identify where the link fails
paragraphs: A product link can fail before or after it reaches LoloBuy. The original seller listing might be unavailable, a shortened address might not resolve, or the import form might fail to capture details from an otherwise live page. Write down what actually happens: an error, an empty preview, a login request or a different product. These observations lead to different checks.

Save the original URL before changing anything. Record the marketplace, visible item identifier if available, intended option and date of the check. A screenshot of the expected item can help, but it should remain connected to the seller link. The aim is to recover enough information for the intended purchase, not merely to make any product page appear in the browser.

sections.heading: Check the original seller listing first
paragraphs: Open the original marketplace listing using its normal public or signed-in access as appropriate. If the seller has removed the item or the desired option is unavailable, reformatting the address does not restore stock. Preserve the seller name, item title and relevant measurements so that you can evaluate another listing as a new candidate. Similar photographs alone do not establish equivalence.

If the original listing is live and shows the intended option, the problem may concern the shared link or its import. Copy the current listing's own share or address link and compare it with the saved version. Let legitimate redirects complete rather than editing the destination blindly. A page that requires account access should be checked through the marketplace's normal process; this guide does not bypass its access controls.

sections.heading: Keep source IDs and catalogue IDs distinct
paragraphs: A product discovery site can assign its own record number to an entry. That number is not necessarily the Taobao, Weidian or 1688 item identifier. On this site, product details use the catalogue record to retrieve the source listing and its matching purchase link. Replacing a marketplace identifier with the number from a local catalogue address can point to an unrelated item or no item at all.

Use the product's matching purchase button when available, then compare the opened page with the source. If the destination is wrong, retain both URLs and report the mismatch. Do not increment or swap numeric IDs until something loads. The returned image, title, seller and option set should jointly match the intended listing. One matching detail is not enough to reconstruct the complete product identity.

sections.heading: Recover Taobao links with the option attached
paragraphs: A Taobao share message can contain descriptive text as well as a link. Copy the actual listing link rather than treating the entire message as an address. If the share link redirects, confirm the resulting item before using that destination in LoloBuy. Keep the original message as a reference when it contains an option description that the address alone does not preserve.

Once the item loads, compare the selected colour, size, quantity and price basis. A successful import may still show the default option rather than the one you intended. Save the original option wording alongside any translation, especially when several options have similar names. If the seller uses a size chart inside an image, preserve that chart and clarify the required measurements before authorising an order.

sections.heading: Check Weidian seller and variant information
paragraphs: For a Weidian listing, verify the seller page and item together. A saved link may remain live while the offer, available variants or price has changed. Compare the current title, images, option names and seller information with your earlier record. Treat a changed listing as a new decision rather than assuming that a familiar product image preserves the old offer.

When the import preview differs from the live seller page, document the specific mismatch. For example, identify which size is absent or which option price is being displayed. Include the original URL and intended selection in the order enquiry. Avoid instructions such as 'the one in the photo' when the listing contains several products or variants. A precise option description is easier for the purchasing team to verify.

sections.heading: Treat 1688 quantity as part of the product
paragraphs: LoloBuy's official 1688 guide says that seller minimum quantities must be met and that price and domestic freight can depend on the purchase amount. An imported price without the matching quantity tier is therefore incomplete. Check whether the listing is priced per piece, pair, set, box or another unit. A low number might describe a component or a larger purchase tier.

Record the minimum quantity, your intended quantity, the selected variants and the price applicable to that combination. If mixed colours or sizes are involved, clarify the seller's conditions rather than assuming that any mixture meets the minimum. The official guide also describes separate inspection considerations for 1688 orders. Resolving a link does not remove those quantity, inspection or return conditions from the buying decision.

sections.heading: Use a manual order only with verified details
paragraphs: The official LoloBuy buying guide describes manually filling a shopping-agent order when product information cannot be captured automatically. Use that option when it is offered for the order and supply the details from the actual listing. Include the original link, exact product and options, quantity, current item price and domestic delivery information where known. Mark unresolved information for clarification rather than inventing it.

A manual form is a way to communicate an order; it is not a guarantee that an unavailable product can be purchased or that every seller will accept the requested terms. Before payment, compare the completed form with the source record. After submission, answer any request for confirmation through the relevant order enquiry. Keep the final confirmed selection so that it can later be compared with warehouse evidence.

sections.heading: Review the imported result before paying
paragraphs: Whether the link was repaired or a manual form was used, perform the same final check. Compare identity, seller, colour, size, quantity, unit and total. Confirm that the displayed amount belongs to the chosen configuration and check domestic delivery separately. A successful preview proves that some information was loaded, not that every required detail was imported correctly or that stock is reserved.

If the source and order form disagree, stop at the disagreement and resolve it specifically. Repeatedly submitting similar orders can make the record harder to follow. Keep one clear evidence trail showing the original listing, the corrected selection and the resulting order reference. When the item reaches the warehouse, compare the received goods with that confirmed record before international parcel submission.

sections.heading: Maintain a link record that can be checked again
paragraphs: Keep the old URL, current URL, marketplace, seller, visible item ID, selected option, date and outcome in a simple record. Useful outcomes include live and matched, live but changed, unavailable option, removed listing or unresolved import. If you find a replacement, retain its own details instead of overwriting the original as though nothing changed. This preserves the reason for your decision.

Recheck the listing immediately before ordering because link recovery does not guarantee future availability. If you share a corrected link, explain the date and what was verified without claiming that the seller or physical goods were independently tested. A reliable product directory helps people discover and verify candidates. Clear records and accurate status information make that useful even when individual marketplace listings change.

checklist: Save the original URL before modifying a link.
Check seller availability separately from LoloBuy import.
Keep catalogue record IDs separate from marketplace item IDs.
Verify 1688 units, minimum quantities and price tiers.
Compare the final imported or manual order with the source.
